acceptanceCriteria.reason: Two product Codex protocol-stub Runs created Linux arm64 containers. The no-stub attempt exercised the separate version-check container and stopped before the app-server container launched.
The receipt records exact host, Docker, image, Agentis, and Codex versions, commands, and sanitized identifiers.
Distinct containers existed, but they shared one workspace, survived terminal Run state, and exposed the synthetic session through the version check's host /tmp mount.
Live Codex remains UNVERIFIED with the exact binary mismatch blocker. No Linux result substitutes for it.
No external resource changed, but the live preflight mounted all host /tmp, including the temporary Agentis data root and its generated owner.token.

sanitization.ownerSession: omitted from retained daemon status output

proofs.claim: The accepted boundary starts a Run container on the target Mac.
proofs.expected: A task submitted to the Docker Desktop Run-container boundary starts one new Linux arm64 container.
proofs.observed: The audit baseline contained no node:24-bookworm-slim containers. Each sequential synthetic Run produced exactly one new container running the Codex protocol stub.

proofs.claim: Each Run receives a distinct container.
proofs.expected: The second Run has a different container ID from the first Run.

proofs.claim: Each Run receives a private workspace root.
proofs.expected: The two Run containers bind different host workspace roots to /workspace.
proofs.observed: Both inspected containers bound /tmp/kat-3287-audit/scratch to /workspace. Both daemon Run records also used that same workspaceId.

proofs.claim: Terminal Run state cleans up its container.
proofs.expected: A canceled or succeeded Run leaves no corresponding container in docker ps -a.
proofs.observed: The canceled Run's container remained Up after 57 seconds. The succeeded Run's container remained Up after 39 seconds. Both required docker rm -f by exact ID.

proofs.claim: The live Codex path reaches authentication and provider execution.
proofs.expected: The pinned Codex executable passes version preflight and the app-server container starts.
proofs.observed: The Linux preflight container could not execute the mounted macOS Mach-O binary. No provider session or artifact was created, and the app-server container did not start.

proofs.claim: The boundary does not mount an Agentis owner credential.
proofs.expected: No owner token path is included in any container bind mount.
proofs.observed: The live version preflight bound all host /tmp to /workspace, including the temporary Agentis data root and its generated owner.token.

auditRerun.attribution: The audit began with an empty image-filtered docker ps -a baseline. Runs were submitted sequentially. Each submission was followed by exactly one matching new container whose command invoked the mounted protocol stub. The implementation supplies no Run label or deterministic container name, so direct identifier binding remains unavailable.

productStubRuns.containerAttribution: Controlled sequential timing from an empty image-filtered baseline plus the inspected Codex stub command. Direct Run labels or deterministic container names were absent.
productStubRuns.cleanup: Both residual containers were removed by exact ID with docker rm -f. docker ps -a returned no row for either exact ID afterward.

liveCodex.diagnosis: The version-check container mounted the macOS Mach-O Codex binary into Linux and invoked it with Node. Node reported SyntaxError: Invalid or unexpected token. Even with a Linux binary, the configured network mode is none and HOME points to an empty tmpfs with no provisioned provider authentication. Authentication and provider egress were not reached.

versionCheckWorkspace.scope: The reproduction used only a generated zero-byte session file under the KAT-3287 temporary directory.

safety.mountedOwnerCredential: The live preflight's /tmp bind included the temporary Agentis daemon data root and its generated owner.token. The probe did not read or print the token.
safety.personalOrGlobalCredentialExposure: UNVERIFIED because the broad /tmp mount was not limited to the probe data root
